description: This file contains the CashFlowValidations class which provides validation methods for financial cash flow parameters such as rate, period type, present value, and future value within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: CashFlowValidations
classes.description: Provides validation methods for cash flow-related parameters such as rate, period type, present value, and future value, ensuring they meet expected types and constraints.

methods.name: validateRate
methods.description: Validates that the rate parameter is a float.

methods.name: validatePeriodType
methods.description: Validates that the period type is either PAYMENT_END_OF_PERIOD or PAYMENT_BEGINNING_OF_PERIOD as defined in FinancialConstants.

methods.name: validatePresentValue
methods.description: Validates that the present value is a float.

methods.name: validateFutureValue
methods.description: Validates that the future value is a float.
